turns.speaker: system
turns.content: "Welcome everyone. We need to decide how to allocate our reduced budget across three projects today. Let's start by hearing each of your perspectives—J, Jordan, Sam, what are your initial thoughts?"

turns.speaker: provoker
turns.content: "Thanks for kicking this off. My project—the client portal overhaul—needs to be our top priority. The current system crashes weekly, and we've got contractual penalties kicking in next month if we don't deliver the upgrades. Anyone suggesting we deprioritize this is basically volunteering to explain to our biggest client why their operations are going offline."
